annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 1465/2024 - Estabelece princípios, garantias, direitos e deveres para o desenvolvimento, a implementação e a aplicação da inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1465/2024 - Establishes principles, guarantees, rights and duties for the development, implementation and application of artificial intelligence in Brazil
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill PL 1465/2024 sets principles, rights and duties for AI. It adopts a three-tier risk model, bans excessive-risk systems such as autonomous weapons, imposes governance and oversight duties on high-risk systems including autonomous vehicles, presumes fault for harm, and provides fines up to 2% of turnover.
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk categories: excessive (prohibited, incl. autonomous weapons), high (incl. autonomous vehicles, health), moderate
High-risk systems require documentation, logging, testing, cybersecurity, incident response plans and human oversight with override and stop ability
Civil liability: presumed fault and reversed burden of proof; strict liability for high-risk systems
Rights to information, explanation, contestation, human review, and non-discrimination
Sanctions: warning, fines up to R$100 million or 2% of Brazilian turnover, publicity of infraction
